# <span id="aanchor172"></span> Temperature Base Editor

The Temperature Base Editor allows you to enter the temperature base values that will be available for selection everywhere a Temperature Base drop-down list is available in FLOWCAL, such as the meter characteristics.

<div class="procedure">

To access the Pressure Base Editor and enter a new value:

1.  Go to **Settings** \> **Settings Manager**.
2.  Select **Temperature Base** within the **Application** group.
3.  Click the **New** button.
4.  Enter the new value in the **Temperature Base** field at the bottom of the screen.
5.  Click the **Save** button.
